scope: Live local Qwen planner-only checks; no retrieval, Writer or Critic was run.

AMD'nin son üç yıllık gelir büyümesini, en son çeyrek sonuçlarını ve son şirket açıklamalarını değerlendir.
Compare Costco and Salesforce annual revenue growth over the last three fiscal years.

limitations: Three prompts do not prove semantic routing correctness for every question.
Normalizer fixes explicit recent/financial_data contradictions only; it does not infer periods from arbitrary prose.
Only exact duplicate instructions with identical agent and period scope are deduplicated.
Full end-to-end latency and answer quality need a subsequent test.
